topic: Locating Places on Earth and Using Resources Sustainably
key_concepts: Earth can be imagined as a globe with imaginary grid lines
Parallels are horizontal lines running west to east
The equator is 0° latitude and divides Earth into Northern and Southern Hemispheres
Parallels measure latitude north or south of the equator
Meridians run from North Pole to South Pole and measure longitude east or west of the Prim
Latitude and longitude are angular measurements in degrees, minutes, and seconds
Coordinates give an exact location on Earth
Natural resources have various human uses
Human activities can harm natural resources
Negative effects on natural resources can be lessened through sustainable practices
Individuals can help protect natural resources
